entry.title: datasette-agent 0.7a1
entry.summary: Release: datasette-agent 0.7a1 I small improvement to Datasette Agent : chat sessions can open an iframe side panel, and that panel can then navigate to different pages. This version improves navigation by fragment hashes, for deeper integration with other Datasette plugins that update fragment hashes when the user interacts with the plugin in a way that changes state. I built this in order to fix some bugs with the much more exciting datasette-charts 0.2a0 release . Tags: datasette-agent…

entry.title: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
entry.summary: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer GLM 5.4 is now available from Chinese AI lab Z.ai. It's their first model to use a looped transformer architecture, which they describe like this: In a standard Transformer, each layer runs once per forward pass. In a Loop Transformer, a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations, refining the hidden states from the previous pass. entry.title: Ladybird's first alpha release
entry.summary: Ladybird is an astonishingly ambitious project: a new browser, in 2026, with its own implementation of most of the key components - HTML parsing, CSS engine, layout, JavaScript, even WebAssembly. It still uses a few external components - things like HarfBuzz for text shaping, Skia for 2D graphics, ffmpeg for video, and SQLite for the things you do with SQLite. Everything else is part of Ladybird, or code brought in from Ladybird's even more ambitious predecessor project SerenityOS . This…
